locations_modified.ambient_tension: The bone-and-brass ziggurat trembles under apocalyptic bombardment. Emerald plasma craters pit Lord Malgakor's daemonic throne. Malgakor bellows in unholy wrath as 2,795 damage tears his outer wards to ribbons, his flaming daemon sword cleaving the trenchline.

completed_milestones.title: Outer Daemonic Wards of Lord Malgakor Breached in Epic Charge
completed_milestones.consequence: Sergeant Kathryn Vane led the entire garrison in an all-out charge for the Emperor: unleashed 12 archeotech plasma salvos, heavy bolters, and Bragg's Power Fist, inflicting a staggering 2,795 net damage to the 12,500 HP Chaos God-Lord.

active_resource_stockpile.quarantine_logistics_alert: DIVINE SIEGE ACTIVE: 2,795 damage inflicted on Chaos God Malgakor (9,705 HP remaining). Phase 1 wards obliterated!

new_decision.decision: Roared 'EVERYONE CHARGE! FOR THE EMPEROR!' and personally led the vanguard into the courtyard of the Dread Citadel, directing archeotech plasma fire to vaporize Malgakor's outer wards and taking shrapnel from exploding daemonic stone.
new_decision.impact: Shattered Phase 1 wards; inflicted massive net damage (Vitality 115 -> 110).

new_decision.decision: Bellowed 'FOR DA SARGE AN' DA GOLDEN BOSS!' and charged the bone gates, slamming his overcharged Power Fist into the primary warp-pylon, dealing 246 kinetic disruption damage and toppling the entrance archway.
new_decision.impact: Cleared the breach lane for the assault team (Vitality 75 -> 70).

new_decision.decision: Emptied overcharged sun-fire salvos from his Mark IV Plasma Gun into Malgakor's daemonic energy conduits, vaporizing heretical runes before being blown backward by the warp-backlash.
new_decision.impact: Inflicted nearly 1,500 damage to the outer shield; took caustic warp burns (Vitality 65 -> 54).

new_decision.decision: Marched at the flank of Kastelan Automaton 'Iron Bastion', directing heavy phosphor bursts and autocannon fire into the ziggurat flanks; took daemonic lightning arc across bionic torso.
new_decision.impact: Coordinated suppression fire, breaking the daemon engines (Vitality 85 -> 68).
